name: OmniBench
intro: OmniBench 是要求同时结合图像与音频信息作答的三模态理解基准，包含1,142道四选一问答，覆盖语音、声音事件和音乐三类场景及八类任务。
org: M-A-P, University of Manchester, Queen Mary University of London, 01.AI, HKUST, Nanjing University, Dartmouth College
build_method: 人工三模态问答标注, 交叉质检, 模型辅助单模态可解性过滤
modality: 图像, 音频, 文本
task_type: 三模态理解, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 图像与音频联合必要性, 单模态消融, 人类音乐家基线
build_method_en: Human Tri-modal QA Annotation, Cross-inspection, Model-assisted Unimodal-solvability Filtering
eval_feature_en: Joint image-audio necessity, single-modality ablations, human musician baseline
intro_en: OmniBench is a tri-modal understanding benchmark whose questions require jointly using image and audio evidence. It contains 1,142 four-option QA pairs across speech, sound events, and music, organized into eight task types.
scale_en: 1,142 QA pairs, 3 primary categories, 8 task types
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2409.15272 and the official multimodal-art-projection/OmniBench repository. The diagrams preserve the image-audio-text input and textual-answer contract; three primary categories and eight task types; 16 annotators and five quality inspectors; four-option questions with one correct answer and at least one confusing distractor; the requirement that both image and audio are necessary; minimum 480p images, audio clips of at most 30 seconds, and source/speaker/question repetition limits; transcripts or music captions plus modality-specific rationales; human cross-inspection with revision reasons; three repeated LLaVA-1.6-34B limited-information checks over image-plus-text, transcript-plus-text, and text-only inputs; revision, recycling, or discard of solvable items; the 1,142-question release across speech, sound events, and music; full tri-modal answer-letter accuracy; image/audio ablations and textual approximations; and the human-musician baseline. Video is excluded because it is not a benchmark input modality.
